description: Publish a static site (HTML/CSS/JS/images/fonts/PDF/video) and get its link. Creates a new site when siteId is omitted, otherwise redeploys to the same URL — the link and access settings survive and the previous version stays available for rollback. Pass exactly one source: `dir` (local folder, e.g. the output of a build), `zipPath` (local .zip), `html` (a single page), or `files` ([{path, base64}]). New sites start Restricted (only you). Use neuron_sites_set_access to share. Only changed files are uploaded on redeploy. A new site is reviewed by Neuron once; until approved (`reviewStatus`), visitors can't open it. Its address (`label`) is fixed for life.

delete.description: mode=patch only: site paths to remove, e.g. ['brand/old-logo.png'].

dir.description: Local folder to publish (local MCP only). index.html at its root opens first.

entryPath.description: Page that opens at / when there's no index.html.

files.description: Files as base64 with relative paths.

html.description: A single HTML page; becomes index.html.

label.description: Business plans: the address for a new site (<label>.<sites domain>). Lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens. Can't be changed later. Omit to get one generated.

mode.description: 'replace' (default): the source IS the whole site. 'patch' (needs siteId): start from the live version; the source's files add/replace those paths, `delete` removes paths, everything else carries over. Use patch for a one-file change.

name.description: Name for a new site (required when siteId is omitted).

siteId.description: Existing site to redeploy. Omit to create a new site.

zipPath.description: Local .zip to publish (local MCP only). A single top-level folder is unwrapped.

name: neuron_sites_publish
title: Publish Site
